items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: But the young man who took over Juilliard back in 1945, William Shuman, the composer, that was his idea.

ctx.x: That's what I said -- all that was just a political move at the time; everybody was saying they were interested in the history of jazz and the black music, but that was just politics.
But the young man who took over Juilliard back in 1945, William Shuman, the composer, that was his idea.
